text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Up on stage, the winner of today's race
is holding
a concert to celebrate.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, everyoooone! Thanks for all your
support!
I'll definitely see you here again
next time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon's concert ends in an
eruption of
applause.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now that the concert is over, I figure I
should
head back to the academy, but...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ryan! Thanks for waiting! Sorry for being
late. I
had to clean up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Great performance today! You came just
in time.
The next bus is the last one back
to school.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
But anyways, your concert was a massive
success!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but I wish that last dance move
had gone a
bit better.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Really? Hmm, wait. Falco, look behind
you...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon looks back and sees a
young
Umamusume facing her.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Um, hi, Falco! I was in the front row at
your
concert! You were so pretty and
cute and sparkly!
It was amazing!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Aww, you were watching?! I'm so happy!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Even though I'm an Umamusume, I'm
really slow. I
got really depressed and
thought I was no good.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
But watching your concert made me feel
good
again! I want to race again! And I
wanna dance
like you, Falco!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Oh! I see... You're just like...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I see, I see! Well, isn't that a
beautiful
dream!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I know! How would you like to have a
dance
lesson with me right now?

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Really?! Yes, please!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon teaches the little girl some
simple
dance moves.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
See you later! I'm sure we'll both be
dancing on
stage together one day! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Beaming with satisfaction, the young fan
leaves
with her parents.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon is overjoyed. However...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh crap! Sorry, Ryan. We missed the last
bus
home, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, no worries! It's just a two-hour
run back.
It'll make for some fine
exercise!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Besides, who could blame you after
seeing that
girl's smile?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ryan... Hehe, thanks a lot.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I want to see all my fans' sparkling
dreams come
true! That's the path I
lead! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It's incredible how much your concerts
touch
people's hearts! I really admire
how you do that!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Y-you admire me?! Wait, does that mean
you
want to be an Umadol?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Then do it! Let's be Umadols together!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Uh, no... that's not... quite what I
meant...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You have a well-built physique and a
natural
smile!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: That's all you need. You'd be great! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
How about we shine together?! We can
be a unit!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, would you look at the time?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hey, wait up!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ryaaaaan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I know that look! That determination!
That
passion! It's just like me and
weightlifting!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Weight...lifting?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Weightlifting requires an unyielding
spirit and
unrelenting perseverance!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
And you have both! Yes, I knew from the
start I
could sense a fellow spirit!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Well? You wanna train with me?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Um, well, I, uh... I think my muscles are
pretty
sore today, so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
They're sore! That means they're getting
bigger!
It's proof of your progress!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Soreness equals progress! It's our
chance! Forget
tomorrow, let's do it
today! No! Let's do it now!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: P-please, noooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're already doing some leg
exercises?! All
right! I can't slack off
either!
